description:

- [ ] no test hangs longer than bounded timeout

title: Unflake tailnet repl e2e tests that can hang CI

acceptance_criteria:
**Acceptance**
- [ ] Dry-run command reports candidates and skip reasons without mutation.
- [ ] Apply command applies eligible tombstones and reports applied/skipped/failed counts.
- [ ] JSON output is deterministic and covered by tests.
- [ ] Human output is concise and does not expand default core task context.
- [ ] Missing namespace, unsupported policy, and no-authority cases produce clear errors or skip rows.
- [ ] CLI integration tests cover dry-run and apply against a temp daemon/repo.
description:
**Problem**
Policy GC needs an explicit operator surface before background sweeping is enabled. Operators need to see what would be deleted, why items are skipped, and what was actually applied.

**Files**
- `crates/beads-cli/src/commands/**`
- daemon admin request routing
- rendering/JSON tests
design:
**Design**
Add `bd admin gc --namespace <ns> --dry-run --json` and `bd admin gc --namespace <ns> --apply --json`.

Dry-run must be read-only. Apply must call the daemon executor and print structured results. Human output can be compact, but JSON must preserve candidate ids, namespace ids, action, and skip reason.

notes.author: darin@darinsmcstudio2.lan
notes.content: Prediscovery: CLI command modules are under crates/beads-cli/src/commands; admin command parsing/rendering already routes existing admin ops. This bead should be thin over the daemon admin op from beads-rs-9gh7.17. JSON should be the API output directly; human output can summarize counts plus rows. Tests should include one CLI integration using shared crates/beads-rs/tests fixtures, not a bespoke daemon harness.

title: Add bd admin gc dry-run and apply CLI surface
